cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import sys,json,random,subprocess
sys.path.insert(0,'tmp');sys.path.insert(0,'project')
from refcollector import run_case
from wire import packet,payload,MASK
rnd=random.Random(4)
cases=[]
for prim in ['allreduce','reduce','broadcast','barrier','allgather','reducescatter']:
 K=1 if prim=='barrier' else (8 if prim!='reducescatter' else 8)
 D=0 if prim=='barrier' else 2;N=4;start=0xfffff0
 ev=[]
 # some valid data
 for i in range(20):
  r=rnd.randrange(4);p=rnd.randrange(K)
  ev.append({'op':'wire','rank':r,'hex':packet(r,(start+p)&MASK,payload(3,p,r,D)).hex()})
 # arbitrary ack physicals
 for i in range(20):
  r=rnd.randrange(4);phys=rnd.choice([(start-2)&MASK,(start-1)&MASK,start& MASK,(start+K)&MASK,(start+3*K+1)&MASK,rnd.randrange(1<<24)])
  ev.append({'op':'wire','rank':r,'hex':packet(r,phys,ack=True).hex()})
 # valid frames wrong rank endpoints using rank different from event
 for i in range(10):
  frame_r=rnd.randrange(4);ev_r=(frame_r+1)%4;p=rnd.randrange(K)
  ev.append({'op':'wire','rank':ev_r,'hex':packet(frame_r,(start+p)&MASK,payload(9,p,frame_r,D)).hex()})
 ev += [{'op':'flush'},{'op':'retry','rank':rnd.randrange(4)},{'op':'snap','tag':'x'}]
 c={'primitive':prim,'mode':rnd.choice([2,3]),'root':rnd.randrange(4),'segments':K,'words':D,'capacity':N,'start':start,'events':ev,'trace':32}
 cases.append(c)
for lo in range(0,len(cases),8):
 sub=cases[lo:lo+8]
 p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'project/solver.py'],input=json.dumps({'cases':sub}).encode(),stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
 print('ret',p.returncode,p.stderr[:100])
 out=json.loads(p.stdout)['cases']
 for i,c in enumerate(sub):
  exp=run_case(c)
  if out[i]!=exp:
   print('MISMATCH',c['primitive'])
   for k in exp:
    if out[i][k]!=exp[k]:print(k,out[i][k],exp[k])
   raise SystemExit(1)
print('OK valid raw')
PY
